source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: openProgressDialog takes a parent window, dialog URL and typed compose parameters. It passes the progress object and parameters directly as dialog arguments and uses fixed chrome/dependent/centerscreen options. sendMsg takes four caller arguments, ending with progress. Message-window association is still an explicit progress property or SetMsgWindow call; shortening the signatures does not remove that caller role. Historical status-feedback wiring differs from accepted source and does not establish a leak cure.
title: Progress dialog arguments and message-window association are separate contracts
